Describe the pages, sections, examples, or templates added or corrected.

## 🔎 Accuracy review
- [ ] Commands match the current package scripts.
- [ ] Technical details were checked against the current repository.
- [ ] Relative Markdown links were reviewed.
- [ ] No unsupported features or environment variables were invented.
